question.prompt:
The lateral surface of a cylinder unfolds into a rectangle. If its base circumference is 10 and its height is 4, what is its lateral surface area?

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_h110_q3_question_en.svg)

solutions.explanation:
The lateral surface area equals the base circumference multiplied by the height. Here, the circumference is given directly, so there is no need to calculate with \(\pi\) again.

Thus the lateral surface area is \(10\times4=40\) square units.
solutions.title: Circumference times height
